notes: Ontology plan and CQ coverage have been documented. The ontology will model the full EDIFACT hierarchy, segment-to-element mapping, role reification, organizational roles, addresses, identifiers, line items, prices, taxes, and validation constraints. OWL2 DL datatypes will be strictly followed. Each property and class will have rdfs:label and rdfs:comment. Disjoint unions and subclass hierarchies will be explicitly modeled. Ready to generate the initial OWL code in Turtle syntax.

pitfall_descriptions: Inverse relationships not explicitly declared (owl:inverseOf missing for object properties)
iterations.fix_applied: Add owl:inverseOf for all object properties as appropriate.

refinement_plan_1.analysis: High-priority improvements are required for CQ coverage and explicit validation modeling. CQ5 (organization details) and CQ8 (item details) are only partially addressed: Organization lacks properties for contact info, legal status, etc.; Item lacks description, SKU, unit of measure. CQ13 (validation/modeling of mandatory fields) is only partially addressed: ValidationConstraint exists, but no explicit modeling of mandatory fields or directory requirements. High-priority constraint/quality issues: No formal OWL restrictions, no equivalentClass axioms, no GCAs, minor risk of missing domain/range, no technical segment/element code mappings. Plan: 1) Extend Organization with properties for contact info (email, phone), legal status, trading name, VAT number, etc.; 2) Extend Item with properties for description, SKU, unit of measure, brand; 3) For ValidationConstraint, model mandatory fields (e.g., via annotation or OWL restriction), add directory-specific requirements (e.g., cardinality, must-have properties); 4) Add owl:equivalentClass and allValuesFrom/someValuesFrom restrictions for InvoiceMessage, LineItem, RoleAssignment; 5) Add at least one GCA for semantic validation (e.g., InvoiceMessage must have detail section with line items, total amount equals sum of line item prices plus taxes); 6) If possible, add segment/element code mappings and delimiter modeling. Constraints: Maintain OWL2 DL compliance, preserve existing correct elements, annotate all new elements, validate thoroughly.
